newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ever Gotesco seeks 100 mln peso loan.
newsitem.headline: Ever Gotesco seeks 100 mln peso loan.

text.p: Real estate developer Ever-Gotesco Resources and Holdings Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors had approved a resolution seeking bank loans amounting to 100 million pesos.

Acting corporate secretary Carlos Wilfredo Pineda told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the company would apply to state-owned Land Bank of the Philippines for a 100 million peso credit line which will include short-term loans and letters of credit.
The company did not specify how the proceeds will be used.
